title: Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A Flask web application that uses AI agents (CrewAI/LangChain/OpenAI) to generate privacy-safe synthetic datasets across multiple industry domains, with anti-plagiarism similarity checks and PII/k-anonymity privacy protection. It runs SDV's CTGAN, TVAE, and GaussianCopula synthesizers (via sdv.single_table) to produce the synthetic tabular data itself.
evidence: app/tools/generate.py:23-72 imports CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer from sdv.single_table and calls synthesizer.fit(processed_df)
